title: Core Lean theorem template corpus
description: A local-first starter corpus of reusable theorem families for agent handoff. This manifest organizes formal targets; it is not proof evidence by itself.

families.title: Propositional proof skeletons
evidenceRequired: accepted proof-check record for the concrete copied theorem source
proof-safety scan with no sorry, admit, hole, local axiom, or local constant markers
families.nextAction: Use these as scaffolds for implication, conjunction, and small propositional rewrites before escalating to mathlib.

families.title: Existential witness construction
evidenceRequired: accepted proof-check record for the concrete copied theorem source
reviewed mapping from informal witness claim to the formal statement
families.nextAction: Use for small witness-bearing claims where the agent must name the witness explicitly.

families.title: Natural-number identity rewrites
evidenceRequired: accepted proof-check record for the concrete copied theorem source
route or validation-plan scope when the proof is meant to close a claim gate
families.nextAction: Use for tiny Nat/equality rewrites while larger algebra remains a CAS or mathlib escalation.

families.title: Planned mathlib algebra families
evidenceRequired: Docker proof profile that checks at least one algebra theorem family with no runtime network
reviewed theorem statements mapped to source route or validation gates
families.nextAction: Promote one bounded algebra family into a pinned mathlib fixture after the core template stays green.

escalationGates.title: Pin mathlib dependency revisions
evidenceRequired: Docker proof run that succeeds without runtime network

escalationGates.title: Attach theorem proofs to exact route or validation gates
evidenceRequired: matching route id, obligation id, statement, and statement hash when closing a route

warnings: This corpus manifest organizes formal targets only; it never upgrades trust labels.
Core-Lean theorem families are scaffolds. New claims still need concrete accepted proof-check records.
Planned mathlib families require a pinned dependency manifest and reviewer run before they can become evidence.
